hero.title: Access for
hero.intro: At Reel Sphere, we believe access to movies and series should be inclusive for everyone. Our platform is designed with accessibility at its core—combining modern streaming technology with thoughtful, user-first design.

screenReaders.title: Semantic Soundscapes
screenReaders.description: Reel Sphere is fully optimized for screen readers such as VoiceOver and NVDA. We use semantic HTML and ARIA attributes to ensure all users can navigate and enjoy movies and series with ease.

visualClarity.title: Visual Precision
visualClarity.description: Our interface is designed for clarity and comfort, with high contrast ratios and a carefully selected color palette to reduce eye strain during extended viewing sessions.

keyboardNavigation.title: Keyboard Navigation
keyboardNavigation.description: Navigate the entire platform without a mouse. Reel Sphere supports full keyboard interaction with clear focus states and logical navigation flow.

transcripts.title: Descriptive Transcripts
transcripts.description: We provide subtitles and are continuously improving audio descriptions to ensure all movies and series are accessible to a wider audience.

support.title: Need Help?
support.description: Having trouble or noticed something we can improve? Our team is ready to support you and make your Reel Sphere experience better.
